sections.title: Pratham Khand - Mahavakya ka Dwar
paragraphs: Pichhle adhyay me humne neti-neti ko samjha: yeh nahi, yeh nahi. Sharir jana ja raha hai, mann jana ja raha hai, bhavna, role, kahani aur spiritual experience bhi jane ja rahe hain. Jo badalta hai, jo aata-jata hai, jo jana ja raha hai, vo antim main nahi ho sakta.

Lekin Advaita sirf "yeh nahi" par nahi rukta. Jab pehchan ki safai ho jaati hai, tab ek seedha sanket chahiye. Yahi sanket Mahavakya dete hain. Mahavakya ka arth hai - mahan vakya. Ye mahan isliye hain kyunki ye seedhe tumhare sachche swaroop ki taraf sanket karte hain.

Neti-neti galat pehchan ko halka karti hai. Mahavakya sahi disha dikhate hain. Neti kehti hai: sharir nahi, mann nahi, role nahi, kahani nahi. Mahavakya kehte hain: ab us jaanne wali upasthiti ko dekho jo in sabko jaanti hai.

Is adhyay me hum chaar Mahavakya ko saral bhasha me samjhenge: Tat Tvam Asi - Tum Vahi Ho. Aham Brahmasmi - Main Brahm Hoon. Ayam Atma Brahma - Yah Atma Brahm Hai. Prajnanam Brahma - Chetna Hi Brahm Hai.

Is course me Atma ka arth hai: andar pehchana gaya sachcha swaroop. Brahm ka arth hai: wahi satya apne sarvavyapi aur aseem sandarbh me. Mahavakya in dono ko alag-alag nahi rehne dete. Ye batate hain ki andar ka satya aur sarvavyapi satya alag nahi.

Mahavakya ko ego ke haath me mat do. Agar ahankar kahe, "main Brahm hoon, isliye main special hoon," to baat galat disha me chali gayi. Mahavakya ahankar ko bada karne ke liye nahi, uski pakad ko halka karne ke liye hain.

Mahavakya ko sunne se pehle dheere dekho: sharir jana ja raha hai, mann jana ja raha hai, emotion jana ja raha hai, role aur story jani ja rahi hai, ego bhi jana ja raha hai. Ab pucho: jo yeh sab jaanta hai, vo kya hai?

Aaj ka abhyas: thoda rukkar dekho - sharir jana ja raha hai, mann jana ja raha hai, emotion aur kahani jani ja rahi hai. Phir dheere se andar suno: "Tum vahi ho." Isko prove mat karo. Bas dekho yeh vakya tumhe kis disha me modta hai.

sections.title: Dwitiya Khand - Tat Tvam Asi: Tum Vahi Ho
paragraphs: Pehla Mahavakya hai: Tat Tvam Asi - Tum Vahi Ho. Yeh chhota sa vakya bahut gehra hai. Isko jaldi me samajhne ki koshish mat karo. Isko ek living pointer ki tarah suno.

Yahan "tum" ka arth sharir nahi hai. Sharir badalta hai, thakta hai, beemar hota hai. "Tum" ka arth mann bhi nahi hai, kyunki mann sochta hai, darrta hai, chahta hai aur badalta rehta hai. "Tum" ka arth ego bhi nahi hai, kyunki ego turant kahega: main special hoon.

Yahan "tum" ka arth hai: vo jaanne wali upasthiti jo sharir, mann, vichar, bhavna, sukh, dukh, safalta, asafalta aur ego ki chal ko jaanti hai. Jab Guru kehta hai "Tum vahi ho," to vo tumhari story, naam ya image se baat nahi kar raha. Vo tumhare sachche swaroop ki taraf ishara kar raha hai.
"Vahi" ka arth hai Brahm - vo aseem satya jo sabka aadhar hai. Brahm koi vastu, vyakti ya alag devata nahi hai. Vo sab naam-rup ke peeche ka ek aadhar hai.

Jaise sone se ring, necklace, bangle aur coin bante hain. Naam aur rup alag, lekin substance ek - sona. Isi tarah sharir-mann anek dikhte hain, experiences alag dikhte hain, par antarik aadhar ek hai.
"Tum vahi ho" ka arth hai: andar jo sakshi-swarup pehchana ja raha hai, vo Brahm se alag nahi. Yeh sharir-mann ko bada banana nahi hai. Yeh sharir-mann se pare sachche swaroop ki taraf sanket hai.

Wave aur ocean ka example lo. Wave apne form se dekhe to kehti hai: main chhoti hoon, main badi hoon, main mit jaungi. Lekin apni nature dekhe to samjhegi: main water hoon, aur ocean bhi water hai. Form me seema hai, essence me alagpan nahi. Sadhak body-mind form me seemit dikhta hai, par sachche swaroop me Brahm se alag nahi.

Is vakya ko life me kaise sunna hai? Criticism aaye aur experiencer kahe, "main chhota ho gaya," to dekho - chhota mehsoos kar raha mann hai. Jo jaanta hai, vo abhi bhi hai. Tum vahi ho. Success aaye aur ego kahe, "main bada hoon," to dekho - bada hone ka bhav uth raha hai. Tum vahi ho, success nahi.
Tat Tvam Asi sahi samajh me aaye to pride nahi, vinamrata aati hai. Agar pride aaye, to ego ne pakad liya. Agar separation halka ho aur karuna badhe, to disha sahi hai.

Aaj ka abhyas: kisi strong experience ke dauran rukkar dekho - experience jana ja raha hai, body-mind react kar raha hai, experiencer ise apna banana chahta hai. Phir dheere se suno: "Tum vahi ho." Isko claim nahi, direction banao.

sections.title: Tritiya Khand - Aham Brahmasmi aur Ayam Atma Brahma
paragraphs: Ab Guru ke "Tum vahi ho" ke baad sadhak ke andar ek aur pehchan khulti hai: Aham Brahmasmi - Main Brahm Hoon. Is vakya ko bahut sambhal kar samajhna hai. Yahan "main" ego wala main nahi hai.

Agar body-mind wala main kahe, "main Brahm hoon," to ego spiritual language pehen lega. Isliye pehle saaf samjho: Aham Brahmasmi me "main" ka arth hai sakshi-swarup Atma, vo shant jaanne wali upasthiti jo sharir-mann ko jaanti hai par unse seemit nahi hoti.
Brahm ka arth hai vo aseem satya jo sabka aadhar hai. To Aham Brahmasmi ka sahi arth hai: apne sachche swaroop me main sharir-mann tak seemit nahi hoon. Main Atma hoon, aur Atma Brahm se alag nahi.

Yeh ahankar ka claim nahi, pehchan ki shanti hai. Jab ego bolta hai "main Brahm hoon," to bhaari-pan aur superiority aati hai. Jab Atma ki pehchan me yeh spasht hota hai, to maun, saralta aur karuna aati hai.

Behavior ke level par life chalti rahegi. Sharir ko bhojan chahiye, kaam karna hai, relation nibhana hai, seva aur karuna rakhni hai. Aham Brahmasmi vyavahar ko nahi mitata; andar ki pehchan ko clear karta hai.

Ab teesra Mahavakya: Ayam Atma Brahma - Yeh Atma Brahm Hai. Is course me Atma ka arth hai andar pehchana gaya satya. Brahm wahi satya sarvavyapi aur aseem sandarbh me. Is vakya ka arth hai: andar pehchani gayi Atma aur Brahm do nahi.
Atma ko chhoti private cheez mat samjho. Bodies alag hain, minds alag hain, stories alag hain. Lekin jaanne ki upasthiti ko vastu ki tarah alag-alag nahi baanta ja sakta.

Ghatakash ka example lo. Kai ghade hain, unme space alag-alag dikhta hai. Lekin ghada tootne par space nahi tootta. Ghada boundary banata hai; space limited nahi hota. Body-mind ghade jaise hain. Chetna apne satya me body-mind me band nahi.
"Main Brahm hoon" ko quiet rakhna hai. Isko announcement mat banao. Agar yeh sahi jagah utarta hai to vinamrata, karuna, zimmedari aur kam reaction me dikhega.

Aaj ka abhyas: shaant hokar dekho - sharir jana ja raha hai, vichar-bhavna jani ja rahi hai, "main" ki story bhi jani ja rahi hai. Phir andar suno: Aham Brahmasmi. Ayam Atma Brahma. Inhe claim mat banao. Inhe shant direction banne do.

sections.title: Chaturth Khand - Prajnanam Brahma aur Adhyay ka Samapan
paragraphs: Chautha Mahavakya hai: Prajnanam Brahma - Chetna Hi Brahm Hai. Yahan Chetna ka arth sirf thinking ya mental alertness nahi hai. Is course me Chetna vo jaanne ka prakash hai jiske karan vichar, bhavna, sharir aur jagat jane jaate hain. Chetna ke bina koi experience possible nahi.

Abhi shabd dikh rahe hain, meaning samajh aa raha hai, body me sensations ho sakti hain, thoughts aa sakte hain. Yeh sab kaise jana ja raha hai? Vichar aate hain - jane jaate hain. Emotions uthte hain - jane jaate hain. Body sensations jani jaati hain. Silence bhi jana jaata hai. Is jaanne ke prakash ko hum Chetna kahenge.

Chetna vichar nahi; vichar Chetna me aate hain. Chetna emotion nahi; emotion Chetna me jana jaata hai. Chetna body nahi; body Chetna me experience hoti hai. Chetna mann nahi; mann Chetna me jana jaata hai.

Sakshi aur Chetna ka sambandh gehra hai. Sakshi vo shant jaanne wali upasthiti hai jo sharir-mann-sukh-dukh ko dekhti hai. Chetna vo prakash hai jisme poora experience-field sambhav hota hai. Sakshi dwar hai, Chetna us dwar ki gehraai hai. Mahavakya kehta hai: Chetna hi Brahm hai.

Chetna ko special experience mat banao. Mann sochta hai: mujhe light ka experience hona chahiye, bliss aana chahiye, deep state aani chahiye. Lekin jo bhi experience aayega, vo Chetna me jana jayega. Light aayi - jani gayi. Anand aaya - jana gaya. Shanti aayi - jani gayi. Chetna vo nahi jo aati-jaati hai; Chetna vo hai jisme aana-jaana jana jaata hai.

Life me isko kaise jeena hai? Praise aaye - shabd aur khushi Chetna me jane gaye. Criticism aaye - shabd, body ki kasawat, mann ki chot Chetna me jani gayi. Success aaye - anand jana gaya. Failure aaye - nirasha jani gayi. Fear aaye - fear jana gaya. Peace aaye - peace bhi jani gayi.

Chetna ki samajh udasinata nahi laati. Agar koi dukhi hai, to yeh mat kaho: sab Chetna hai, dukh ka matlab nahi. Vyavahar me dukh ko sunna hai, madad karni hai, karuna rakhni hai. Jab alagpan halka hota hai, karuna swabhavik hoti hai.

Chaar Mahavakya ek saath dekho: Tat Tvam Asi - Tum Vahi Ho. Aham Brahmasmi - Main Brahm Hoon. Ayam Atma Brahma - Yeh Atma Brahm Hai. Prajnanam Brahma - Chetna Hi Brahm Hai. Ye sab ek hi satya ko alag-alag disha se dikhate hain.

Nididhyasan ka arth hai: sune aur samjhe satya me baar-baar lautna. Yeh sirf dhyan me baithna nahi, balki life ke beech sakshi me lautna hai. Jab body-identification aaye, yaad karo. Jab mann uljhe, laut jao. Jab ego claim kare, Mahavakya ko shant suno.
Agle adhyay me hum Turiya Avastha ki taraf chalenge. Hum jagrat, swapna aur sushupti ko dekhenge, aur phir us achal jagrukta ko samjhenge jo in teeno ko jaanti hai par kisi ek me simit nahi hoti.

Is saptah ka abhyas: roz ek baar dekho - sharir jana ja raha hai, mann jana ja raha hai, emotion jani ja rahi hai, ego ki kahani jani ja rahi hai. Phir andar suno: Tat Tvam Asi. Aham Brahmasmi. Ayam Atma Brahma. Prajnanam Brahma. Har vakya ke baad thoda maun. Special experience mat dhoondo. Bas dekho yeh vakya tumhe kis shant disha me le jaate hain.
